claims: The same commit holds a regularized drawing of the same packing, tt_n154_regularized.cert, at the same S' and S*, with rotation groups cut from 24 to 16 by angle moves the source path-checks at S*; the claim rests on tt_n154.cert.

The packing came from a time-travel test of the author's size-chaining explorer restarted from the 5 October register, and, by the issue's comment of 2026-10-12T14:13Z, descends from Francisco Couzo's 5 October n = 155 packing with one square removed, after 17 productive rounds at n = 154; the source calls it a different local minimum from T-136's packing, at RMS matching distance 0.319 per square.

KKT multipliers, the reduced Hessian modulo 45 exact flat motions and the corner-to-corner jamming MILP are numerical evidence at 80 digits, as the source says, not proofs; no closed form, interval proof of local optimality or optimality is claimed.
